statement: A corporation formed outside Florida registers to transact business in Florida by filing the Application by Foreign Corporation for Authorization to Transact Business (form CR2E007) with the Division of Corporations, paying the $70 registration fee ($35 filing plus $35 registered-agent designation), attaching a certificate of existence from the home jurisdiction no more than 90 days old, and naming a Florida registered agent who signs an acceptance of the appointment.
caveat: The 'transacting business' trigger is a § 607.1501, Florida Statutes analysis this rule does not resolve; certified copies and certificates of status are optional extras, and the first annual report comes due the following January 1-May 1 window. dos.fl.gov and form.sunbiz.org 403 plain non-browser clients, so verification used a standard browser user agent.
